info.title: Sotto API
info.description: Core /api/v1 surface consumed by the Sotto terminal client. Generated from the Zod contract registry in @sotto/shared.

bearerAuth.description: A long-lived Sotto API key (sk_sotto_...) minted via /api/v1/auth/pair/redeem.

playClaimantProof.name: X-Sotto-Play-Proof
playClaimantProof.description: A private proof for one pending game invitation and credential delivery. A room code or request ID is not this proof.

get.summary: List only my rooms, including expired and completed games.

post.summary: Create a private room idempotently.

get.summary: Read my personalized game state. Hidden partner content is omitted.

post.summary: Apply a revision-checked room or round action idempotently.
Renew or release this foreground host view. A released nonce cannot be reused.

get.summary: Host-only recovery of the current code. Returns null if unavailable.

post.summary: Host-only invitation rotation. Revokes old pending admissions.

get.summary: Host-only list of pending entry requests.
Server-owner-only list of pending persistent profile enrollments.
Preview a valid invitation without creating a profile or request.

post.summary: Request admission with a fresh claimant proof. EXISTING additionally requires current app admission. BROWSER requires canonical browser origin.

get.summary: Read only the proof-bound claimant status.

post.summary: Explicit server-owner enrollment or live game-host entry approval.

Claim or recover the exact proof-bound admission. EXISTING also requires its current app credential. BROWSER requires canonical origin and expectedProfileId (null for an unselected browser), and sets only an HttpOnly session cookie. NATIVE returns one app-only credential.
Erase retained credential-delivery material after durable client receipt.

get.summary: Read my private phrase notebook.

post.summary: Save a bounded selection of visible game language to my notebook.

get.summary: Liveness and dependency health for the instance.
List the authenticated learner's courses.

delete.summary: Permanently delete a course and everything tied to it.

get.summary: Due counts per skill, total vocab, and recent practice sessions.

post.summary: Admit durable practice preparation or resume the original request.

get.summary: Restore saved material, progress, feedback or preparation status.

patch.summary: Save learner answers and drafts under the current progress revision.

post.summary: Cancel saved preparation or acknowledge an interrupted outcome for guarded recovery.
Grade a practice session and update spaced-repetition state.

get.summary: Learner-marked words, phrases, and sentences for focused practice.

post.summary: Add or refresh a learner-marked difficult word, phrase, or sentence.
Attach a visual cue to a learner-marked target when configured.
Generate pronunciation audio for a learner-marked target when configured.

get.summary: Episode detail with ordered segments and playable audio URLs.
Poll grading status for an uploaded speaking attempt.

post.summary: Create/advance to the next gated class (or report the course done).

get.summary: A gated class with its ordered, mixed-skill sections.

post.summary: Queue class repair or regeneration against the observed attempt.
Grade a class submission and release the gate on pass.
Queue interpretation of exercise context and learner ink for review before grading.

get.summary: Read the private interpretation for the current class exercise.

post.summary: Start a full-length mock exam for a course.

get.summary: A mock exam with its ordered sections and (once scored) result.

post.summary: Score a completed mock exam and return the band breakdown.

get.summary: Generate an adaptive placement batch for a native/target pair.

post.summary: Submit placement answers; assign a CEFR level and create the course.
Deduce a CEFR level from pasted materials (creates no course).
Accept the deduced level; create the course and seed note + vocab.
Declare a CEFR level manually; create the course or raise to it.

get.summary: The course's vocabulary/grammar memory graph.
The exam this course can sit plus the learner's past attempts.
Daily study activity and streaks for the learner.
Instance + owner config (self-hosted, owner, non-secret infra).
The authenticated learner identity (id, name, email).

post.summary: Ask a contextual question about an episode; queues an answer.

get.summary: Poll an interaction until it is ANSWERED with answer text.

post.summary: Exchange a single-use pairing token for a long-lived API key.
